panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Comic cover, low angle. Exactly four kids stand at the bottom looking up, left to right: {{maya}}; {{theo}}; {{zara}}; {{dev}}. Behind them towers a round brass vault door in dark blue stone. {{vex}} floats upper right. Top quarter plain dark.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Close-up of {{theo}} holding up one finger, thinking hard, lit by a cyan glow in a dark stone stairwell. The top third is empty dark stone.
